NCT00003406.rationale: Eligibility expressly allows a prior history of CSF tumor involvement when asymptomatic and now disease-free on lumbar puncture/brain CT; active leptomeningeal involvement remains excluded. Mixed malignancies include solid tumors; no named tumor-specific LM cohort is established.

NCT00667615.rationale: DLBCL eligibility expressly allows a history of lymphomatous meningitis when stable without CNS/leptomeningeal recurrence and off steroids or on a stable dose. Active disease and primary CNS lymphoma remain excluded. Hematologic LM: general results only.

NCT01527149.rationale: Mantle-cell lymphoma inclusion expressly states that a lumbar puncture demonstrating mantle-cell lymphoma is not an exclusion for enrollment, despite exclusion of symptomatic meningeal or parenchymal CNS lymphoma. CSF-positive asymptomatic lymphoma provides a genuine LM path; general only.

NCT01977209.rationale: Stage IIIB/IV NSCLC inclusion explicitly permits a brain/meningeal metastasis history after surgery or radiotherapy and at least two months of clinical stability. The eligible meningeal path is tied to NSCLC.

NCT03215095.rationale: Recurrent/metastatic thyroid carcinoma eligibility explicitly permits treated leptomeningeal carcinomatosis; patients must be off steroids used for CNS/LM disease. OTHER_SOLID only.

NCT03283137.rationale: CLL/B-cell NHL eligibility expressly permits previously treated CNS lymphoma and/or lymphomatous meningitis after at least four weeks of imaging stability, neurologic recovery, and seven days off steroids. Hematologic LM: general only.

NCT03401853.rationale: Relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma or DLBCL eligibility explicitly permits previously treated lymphomatous meningitis after four weeks of imaging stability, neurologic recovery, and seven days off steroids. General only.

NCT05807893.rationale: Stage IV non-squamous NSCLC inclusion explicitly allows local meningeal metastases alongside qualifying parenchymal brain lesions; extensive meningeal disease is excluded. LUNG only.

NCT05984108.rationale: The primary meningeal melanocytic-tumor inclusion and named meningeal melanoma/melanomatosis cohorts explicitly include malignant leptomeningeal-origin disease; the summary distinguishes malignant melanomatosis from benign melanocytosis. The exclusion concerns metastatic extrameningeal melanoma, not primary malignant meningeal cohorts. MELANOMA is supported by the explicitly named malignant melanoma cohort; no GBM or OTHER_SOLID assignment.

NCT06492915.rationale: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma exclusion of active/untreated brain or meningeal metastases is followed by an explicit enrollment exception for treated, asymptomatic disease with imaging stability for four weeks, measurable extra-CNS disease, and two weeks off systemic steroids/anticonvulsants. The exception applies to the preceding meningeal population; it is not limited to brain metastases (which appear only as an example of stability). OTHER_SOLID only.

NCT03423628.rationale: LM is a named registry condition, and Arm B (solid-tumor brain metastases) specifically addresses seizure history related to LMD. GBM belongs to separate Arms A/C without an explicit GBM LM path. Retain overall LM relevance and OTHER_SOLID; remove unsupported GBM assignment. Study is now COMPLETED; historical cohort closure remains separate from relevance.

NCT04527549.rationale: Current registry and public protocol EA6191 v2023-01-19 section 3.1.30 exclude leptomeningeal disease or symptomatic/untreated/unstable cord-compression metastases. The modifier scope is ambiguous and the following steroid exception does not specifically establish an eligible LM path. Brain-metastasis permissions and generic non-measurable-disease definitions cannot establish LM inclusion. Conservatively remove unsupported relevance/MELANOMA assignment.
